quotes.name: Elena Soria Dominguez
quotes.quote: Honestly, I can't say the visioning is what's pulling those extra riders in — we're still in the design phase, no shovels in the ground, and most people aren't staring at renderings on their way to work. The growth we're seeing on the row tracks more with what's happening in East Oakland — the events, the crowds, the energy that's been building out here. But I'll tell you this: the workers on the construction site, the ones taking their breaks under the overpass, they see it from the platform every day. They're the ones who'll tell you the station's already becoming a place people want to be, even before Phase II is real.

quotes.quote: Wednesday's a normal workday for me, so I can't say I noticed any big jump on my runs. Most of them got on heading toward the Lake Merritt and downtown stops, not so much out to the edges.
